snippet.title: TOM DAHL - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A trailer for TOM DAHL, my new psychological horror game releasing on October 1st, 2025.

As a rookie cop, you are assigned to watch over a prisoner, but not just any prisoner... The infamous Tom Dahl. However, what makes the job interesting is that Tom is invisible...but only to you. Why can everyone else see him but you can't? Is this some sort of joke? Answers come at a price at the Montgomery Hills Jail. There are only two rules with Tom: Never take your eyes off of his cell and never say his name.

This game was made in two weeks as a personal challenge. I hope you enjoy it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4003500/Tom_Dahl/
